name: Toronto
tagline: The sandwich Bourdain went back for at the world's best market, and the four-star review that cemented chef Patrick Kriss's reputation.

Sushi Masaki Saito.description: Eleven-seat omakase from chef Masaki Saito, once holding two Michelin stars. Today it holds one.

Carousel Bakery.description: Canada's most famous peameal bacon sandwich, at the St. Lawrence Market — named the world's best market by National Geographic. Bourdain and Bobby Flay both went back for seconds.

Gryfe's Bagel Bakery.description: A Jewish bakery on Bathurst Street since the 1930s, hand-rolling and baking its bagels to the same family recipe for more than three generations.

Alo.description: Contemporary French cuisine from chef Patrick Kriss, atop a heritage downtown building. Michelin star, and a four-star review from critic Chris Nuttall-Smith in The Globe and Mail.

Seven Lives Tacos y Mariscos.description: Baja California-style tacos in the heart of Kensington Market, one of the neighborhood's most beloved spots.
